test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2
subject: general
question:
**Identify the segment in the sentence which contains a grammatical error.**

As I was sitting in the back of the theatre, I couldn't see the performance very well.

options.text: in the back of the theatre

solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **in the back of the theatre **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace the preposition '**in**' with '**at**' to correct the sentence.
 
• “**At**” is used when you are at the top, bottom or end of something; at a specific address; at a general location; and at a point.
 
• “**In**” is used in space, small vehicles, water, neighbourhood, city and country.
 
• Here, in the given sentence "**back of the theatre**" refers to a small and specific place.
 
• Therefore, '**at**' should be used.

So, the correct answer is **option 3**, which contains an error.

**The corrected sentence**: *As I was sitting **at __**the back of the theatre, I couldn't see the performance very well. *
